description: This file defines a React component PasswordWizard for changing user passwords, including validation, UI rendering, and interaction logic.

classes.name: PasswordWizard
classes.description: A React component for providing a password change interface with validation and step control.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances the wizard to the next step, validating current password and processing password change.

methods.name: validateCurrentPassword
methods.description: Validates the current password and new password confirmation before submission.

methods.name: processPasswordChange
methods.description: Performs the password change operation, including backup download and encryption key processing.

methods.name: dismiss
methods.description: Closes the modal dialog, unless pending processes are ongoing.

methods.name: setFormDataState
methods.description: Updates form data state with provided partial data.

methods.name: handleCurrentPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Handles input change for current password field.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordInputChange
methods.description: Handles input change for new password field.

methods.name: handleNewPasswordConfirmationInputChange
methods.description: Handles input change for new password confirmation field.
